description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 25.01.2016 - 31.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the determination of exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter issued by the Director General of Customs, involving the exercise of statutory powers to set financial rates and rescind previous notifications. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations.
